Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 11  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified the White House as the landmark featured on the August 2021 Vogue cover. The actual landmark on the cover is the Eiffel Tower, not the White House. This error led to the subsequent calculations being based on the wrong landmark, ultimately resulting in an incorrect answer to the problem.
